Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in task analysis by misinterpreting the entities "Slim Carter" and "Thendral Veesum" as the names of the directors themselves, rather than recognizing them as film titles. This led to the entire research strategy being flawed from the start, as the agent searched for the birth years of the films instead of the directors of those films. The error was compounded by the Planner accepting the WebSurfer's initial search results (which identified the films and their actual directors) without correcting the initial misunderstanding of the task requirements.
